doc_friction.issue: 'pick the project that has gone longest without a new piece' gave no signal: all three shelves and Saints by Candlelight had a piece landed on 2026-11-16; fell back to the BIBLE's headline-shelf proposal
Next up had exactly one H&H proposal, so finishing it empties the shelf; added a new proposal (cantilevered choir gallery) in the same PR

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon (headline shelf). Piece: ten-taps-at-noon (Ollamo, invented, Hadiya Zone, Ethiopia, 15-29 Sep 2063). Text only: audio dirs total 577 MB, over the 400 MB cap. Numbers worked in scratch scripts (Hazen-Williams C 145, orifice taps, minute-by-minute day-tank model) and written into the closing note; weekdays, Meskel 28 Sep 2063 (Ethiopian New Year on 12 Sep before a Gregorian leap year) and ages checked. Adversarial re-read fixed a meter reading that disagreed with the model (0.94 -> 0.81 L/s, tank 1.80 -> 1.64 m), a dusk tank level that contradicted the refill time, a 'four days' that was three, and put the Demera bonfire on the eve of Meskel. Verification: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon 17/17; run_workflow_locally --for-changes output summarised in the PR. No agent doc: nothing a next run needs beyond the BIBLE/DONE entries.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a writer researching and drafting a 5,000-word technical short story with a worked hydraulic model, plus a blog post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
